thread:
Alex: Getting alerts for a surge of 504s hitting hosted inference in eu-west. Multiple customers complaining latency -> timeouts. :rotating_light:
Sam: I'm looking at the gateway logs now, seems like a short window of proxy spikes. P95 latency for gateway up ~2200ms just before the 504s started.
Oncall Bot: Alert: inference-gateway-eu-west - 504 spike - threshold breached (10m).
Taylor: Can you dump the proxy connection stats? suspect conn pool exhaustion or keepalive drops.
Sam: Pasting quick netstat summary from a node:
```
ESTAB  12345  api-client:443  250 connections
TIME_WAIT  ...
SYN_RECV ...
```
Sam: There are lots of long-lived upstream waits to the runtime - kernel backlog looks high.
Maria: Autoscaler shows a partial delay in scaling new dedicated workers due to a recent rollout of the sidecar auth proxy. Could be slow startup + warmup + healthcheck flapping.
Laura: Rolling back the auth-proxy change in eu-west to see if it clears. Janet, please hold planned deploys. :hand:
Jordan (Support): Notifying impacted customers (EU sandbox orgs) with an ETA ~30m for mitigation. I'll include ask for any repro payloads.
Taylor: After rollback, I'll bump the gateway circuit breaker threshold and enable short-term 429->queue fallback so we don't cascade 504s to clients.
Alex: Good. Add an emergency canary to check if the rollout infra is coupling with the scaler (we saw slow readiness probes).
Sam: Rollback is in progress, kube rollout status shows old pod set coming up. If we still see high upstream latency after rollback, I'll add a temporary route to route ~10% of traffic to the secondary region.
Oncall Bot: Deployment rollback initiated by Laura.
Maria: Action note: we need a follow-up to make auth-proxy startup non-blocking for the scaler (healthcheck grace + parallel warmup).
Eng SRE: I'll run heap and FD checks on runtime nodes and add ephemeral increase for conn limits for the next 2 hours.
Jordan (Support): Listed customers updated. Two enterprise customers want root-cause updates and postmortem link when available.
Alex: OK — immediate mitigation checklist: rollback auth-proxy (Laura), increase conn limits (Eng SRE), enable 429->queue fallback (Taylor), customer comms (Jordan).
Taylor: Quick repro snippet for support if asked (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"very long prompt causing large generation"}' --max-time 30
```
Laura: Rollback finished, preliminary gauges show p95 gateway latency dropping back under 400ms. Monitoring for next 10m.
Sam: I'm still seeing a handful of 504s but trending down. Root cause likely auth-proxy readiness + scaler warmup race.
Alex: Great containment. Let's meet tomorrow for a short postmortem sync. Please add immediate action items to the board.
Maria: I'll own follow-ups: (1) change healthcheck grace for auth-proxy, (2) improve autoscaler warmup policy, (3) add a pre-warm step for the runtime when rolling new sidecars.
Eng SRE: I'll own (4) increase ephemeral conn limits and add an alert for keepalive backlog, (5) add a dashboard for proxy start latency.
Taylor: I'll own (6) produce a temporary runtime-side fallback path for queued requests and (7) test circuit breaker tuning.
Jordan (Support): I'll draft the customer-facing note summarizing mitigation and ETA for root-cause postmortem.
Alex: Thanks team. We'll assign owners in the doc and close the loop after the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
